propositions: A ticket declaring file_impact_scope: none must be validated by an advisory LLM criterion to detect false no-file-impact assertions that would silence drift protection.

The no-file-impact criterion must route deterministically using applies_at.require_file_impact_scope: ["none"], selecting only when persisted scope is exactly none and rejecting paths, undeclared, missing, None, and unknown values.

The criterion rubric must evaluate three sub-answer fields (assertion_plausible, reason_grounded, repo_file_change_named) to return PASS for external-only deliverables, advisory contradiction for required repository-file changes, and non-blocking insufficient coaching when the plan is too vague.

The persisted no_file_impact_reason must round-trip through deterministic JSON structured context in the Pass-1 LLM request, preserving quotes, newlines, and Unicode, with missing reasons serialized as explicit empty strings.
External-operator actions and documentation-only changes must be distinguished: reading repository code without editing remains compatible with none, but documentation changes do not.

A defect-seeded routing predicate mutation must cause held-out applicability tests to fail, demonstrating that test coverage validates the deterministic routing contract rather than source-text implementation.
